Product source containment alpha.0.21: all production solution spaces live below src/, Java/Go/Web tests are external under tests/, Maven external test roots and release-manifest depth references are fail-closed validated, while the 120-character path budget and public runtime contracts remain unchanged.

CI deterministic shutdown and Unix archive-compatibility repair alpha.0.23: TaskWorkerPool preserves caller interruption only after bounded executor cleanup, the timing-dependent Workers shutdown regression is removed, PowerShell Maven bootstrap captures java -version stderr without NativeCommandError, and hosted CI remains Unix-only while published ZIP Windows extraction compatibility is enforced by an OS-independent archive gate.

CI coverage repair alpha.0.24: Core Entitlements tests expanded from 13 to 38 and the full Maven reactor switched to fail-at-end diagnostics; hosted JDK25 revealed remaining Entitlements coverage gaps and independent Audit correctness defects, which are closed in alpha.0.25.

CI/JDK25 coverage and audit correctness repair alpha.0.25: Entitlements paid-runtime, manifest-validation and canonical-input branch coverage hardened without JaCoCo exclusions; Audit fixtures preserve requested scopes, signed manifest/control-character validation is fail-closed, concurrent audit tests surface task failures, and independent per-module Maven verification prevents upstream failures from masking downstream JDBC/Server quality defects.

CI/JDK25 reactor and JDBC coverage closure alpha.0.26: Server capability-composition tests follow the real factory signature, independent Maven bootstrap skips test compilation only while installing production artifacts, PostgreSQL 17 is provisioned in Java coverage jobs, canonical migrations are reused, and live JDBC entitlement/revocation contracts are mandatory.

JDBC JSON type-binding hardening alpha.0.27: PostgreSQL JSONB writes use explicit dialect-owned CAST(? AS JSONB) placeholders, Oracle JSON CLOB writes use character streams, Outbox/Audit/Activation share the same binding contract, and Persistence validation blocks direct structured-JSON bindings that can regress to VARCHAR semantics.

CI/JDBC-Server runtime closure alpha.0.28: JDBC activation/revocation error-path coverage is expanded without JaCoCo exclusions, Spring Boot optional-map binding and Modulith configuration-property ownership are corrected, Pro Advanced quota fixtures follow the authoritative catalogue, and a Docker Compose Server/PostgreSQL topology was introduced as executable developer/runtime tooling; alpha.0.29 removes it from the canonical product deployment boundary after the standalone bare-metal/VM requirement was clarified.

Deployment-boundary and Workers composition alpha.0.29: Docker/Compose deployment assets are removed from canonical product source, CI and release metadata and guarded against reintroduction; a separate ignored developer workspace is supported, while Server now owns explicit MEMORY/PostgreSQL/Oracle TaskStore selection, immutable handler registry, scheduler, bounded retry policy and Spring-managed TaskWorkerPool lifecycle.

Developer Docker relocation alpha.0.30: Docker Desktop/Compose tooling is tracked at repository-root docker/ rather than below src/ or in a detached companion bundle; Server and PostgreSQL tooling Dockerfiles, fail-closed backup/restore/rollback scripts, Windows/WSL launchers and Make compose commands are included while production deployment remains standalone bare-metal/VM.

Docker PostgreSQL portability repair alpha.0.31: psql migration/rollback control files use byte-exact printf rendering instead of implementation-defined echo backslash handling, root compose.yaml includes the canonical docker/ model for direct repository-root commands, and service-scoped log helpers prevent generated container names from being confused with Compose service names.

UUIDv7 installation identity repair alpha.0.32: PostgreSQL developer bootstrap no longer uses kernel UUIDv4 identifiers; migration 0007 safely repairs only unconsumed invalid installation identities, enforces the UUIDv7 invariant in PostgreSQL and Oracle, and JDBC reports persisted identifier corruption with column context.

Entitlements temporal precision repair alpha.0.33: PostgreSQL developer bootstrap stores installation created_at at UTC whole-second precision; migration 0008 safely normalizes only unsigned installation metadata, fails closed for fractional signed/HMAC-protected entitlement data, enforces temporal precision in PostgreSQL/Oracle, and JDBC rejects malformed persisted timestamps with column context.

Spring Clock ownership repair alpha.0.34: Entitlements and Workers keep separate UTC Clock beans, every entitlement Clock injection point is explicitly qualified, and a Spring context regression proves the entitlement exception handler resolves the correct clock when both bounded contexts are enabled.

Spring framework Clock arbitration repair alpha.0.35: a canonical UTC platformClock is the sole @Primary Clock for type-only framework integrations such as Spring Modulith Moments, while Entitlements and Workers retain explicit bounded-context qualifiers; architecture and Spring-context regressions prevent ambiguous or accidental primary Clock ownership.

PGM-02-E07 operational readiness alpha.0.37: TaskWorkerPool secret-free snapshot, truthful live-loop/fatal-failure detection, fail-closed Server readiness, fixed-cardinality Micrometer metrics and Docker smoke verification of Workers readiness.

PGM-12-E01 observability foundation alpha.0.38: every Server HTTP dispatch receives a canonical UUIDv7 correlation context, malformed caller identifiers fail closed without reflection, MDC carries correlation_id into Spring Boot ECS structured logs, fixed-cardinality correlation counters are exposed, and Docker smoke verifies propagation/rejection; OpenTelemetry, async/background propagation, systematic masking and dashboards remain pending.

Docker Desktop port-resolution and PowerShell smoke repair alpha.0.40: developer port mappings use explicit loopback short syntax for Windows compatibility, smoke falls back from docker compose port to docker inspect while enforcing 127.0.0.1, and PowerShell variable-colon interpolation is statically guarded.

PGM-12-E01 durable asynchronous correlation alpha.0.42: validated HTTP UUIDv7 correlation is captured by the Server task scheduler, persisted as nullable UUIDv7 worker_task metadata through paired migration 0009, preserved across idempotent replay and process/node boundaries, exposed in TaskExecutionContext, and bound/restored around handler execution without propagating raw headers or security context; OpenTelemetry export, systematic masking and dashboards remain pending.

PGM-12-E01 OpenTelemetry tracing foundation alpha.0.43: Spring Boot OpenTelemetry/OTLP tracing is integrated with W3C Trace Context only, baggage disabled, bounded span/export limits, OTLP export disabled by default, and durable Worker executions emit bounded CONSUMER spans tagged only with validated task type and InfraNexum correlation metadata; sensitive task payloads remain excluded.

PGM-12-E01 sensitive observability redaction alpha.0.44: mandatory ECS structured-value customizer redacts credential-bearing fields and inline password/token/cookie/authorization/URI-userinfo/JWT/private-key material including stack traces, Entitlement RFC Problem details reuse the same policy, runtime log-format override is removed, and manual span attributes remain allowlisted; dashboards/runbooks and target OTLP certification remain pending.

Developer PRO HA topology alpha.0.45: Docker/Compose now models the PRO single_cluster shape with three Patroni-managed PostgreSQL nodes coordinated by three etcd members, one strict synchronous standby, a second replica, HAProxy writer/read routers, four REGIONAL Server nodes behind a readiness-aware HAProxy router, bounded HA failover/rejoin smoke tests and cluster-aware backup/restore/rollback; Web clustering remains deferred and signed activation remains separately certified.

Developer PRO HA etcd healthcheck repair alpha.0.46: official etcd 3.6.14 distroless members are probed with absolute /usr/local/bin/etcdctl exec-form healthchecks instead of CMD-SHELL, eliminating false unhealthy states caused by the image having no /bin/sh while retaining quorum-sensitive endpoint health semantics.

Hosted JDK25 and PRO HA stabilization alpha.0.47: JdbcTaskStore worker INSERT arity is contract-tested after durable correlation, Core Workers coverage scenarios expand without lowering the 98% branch gate, Clock ownership test composition includes the mandatory sensitive-data redactor, Patroni repairs PGDATA to mode 0700 before bootstrap/rejoin, and OTLP metrics export is explicitly opt-in alongside tracing.

PRO HA database bootstrap repair alpha.0.48: PostgreSQL role password setup no longer passes psql-only variable interpolation through --command; the secret is imported from the process environment with psql \getenv and SQL is read from stdin, avoiding both server syntax errors and password exposure in command arguments. The bootstrap now waits boundedly for two streaming standbys and at least one synchronous/quorum standby, eliminating the normal startup race between Patroni/HAProxy health and replication readiness.

Developer PowerShell Compose forwarding repair alpha.0.49: dev-compose.ps1 no longer declares ValueFromRemainingArguments parameters on Docker wrapper functions, so native short switches such as -e, -T and -q remain in the automatic PowerShell $args vector and cannot collide with abbreviated common parameters; a dedicated Compose contract prevents reintroduction of parameter-bound native forwarding while all alpha.0.48 PRO HA bootstrap invariants remain unchanged.

Developer PowerShell Compose capture isolation alpha.0.50: Invoke-ComposeCapture launches Docker through ProcessStartInfo with stdout and stderr independently redirected, so Compose lifecycle progress cannot corrupt scalar stdout consumers; nonzero exits preserve diagnostics without reintroducing native option binding.

Developer PRO Web HA topology alpha.0.51: two non-root Web nodes run behind a readiness-aware HAProxy with a loopback-only stable router on port 8081, Node.js 24.18.1 checksum-verified amd64/arm64 image construction, Server readiness dependency, Web health/runtime-config smoke coverage, and bounded Server/Web single-node failover and rejoin checks; production Web UI certification remains future PGM-05/PGM-14 work.

Developer PRO Web HA Compose schema repair alpha.0.52: Web router healthcheck timing keys interval, timeout, retries and start_period are correctly nested below healthcheck instead of being invalid service-level properties; the Compose contract now fails if those keys escape the healthcheck mapping, preventing docker compose config/down/build/up/ps schema rejection.

Developer PRO HA replication-observability repair alpha.0.53: Docker smoke/ha-smoke keep ordinary application queries on the least-privileged infranexum role but execute pg_stat_replication HA diagnostics through the existing bootstrap postgres identity, avoiding security-restricted dynamic-statistics false negatives without granting pg_monitor or pg_read_all_stats; static and executable POSIX regressions protect the separation.
